source_evidence: The requested toolchain action is expressed in current source: src/vendor/vc6-runtime.recovery.h's RECOVERY_COMPONENT block now binds _abs origin 0x00644F3A spans 0x00644F3A-0x00644F45 unit build/intel/mt_obj/abs.obj (line 67), _ftell origin 0x00647920 spans 0x00647920-0x00647942 unit ftell.obj (line 68) and _memset origin 0x006465F0 spans 0x006465F0-0x00646648 unit memset.obj (line 69), published by commits 0d0b04b0 (abs, ftell) and bd6ca573 (memset through its pinned identity); the finding explicitly reserved this file to coordinator/toolchain-owner action, and that owner has now acted.

Fresh request diagnostics (request_sha256 6254ec95a24092a884ef62e425c636029ca6edd151ca0a02ea6e01b38e187fe3) confirm the hypothesis's predicted effect: checks.binary.unresolved_symbols is now [] where the finding recorded ["_abs","_ftell","_memset"], and the vc6-runtime component_verification now selects abs.obj, ftell.obj and memset.obj among its 12 members, with _abs measuring pass on bytes and references and _memset pass on bytes and references.

The six affected identities (decode_byte_run, decode_byte_run_trans, decode_chunk, UNK3, decode_delta_flc, decode_delta_flc_trans) are no longer unmeasurable: decode_byte_run's fresh variant binds its _memset call to 0x006465F0, its _abs call to 0x00644F3A and fread/free to their already-bound spans, with empty missing/extra/unresolved absolute-relocation lists; the remaining fail results are measured differing-offset byte differences (the documented compiler-side register/slot allocation residuals on these entities), a separate concern from this relocation-binding finding.

Incorporation is expression in source, not binary or behavioral proof, and two tails remain visible: _ftell's own component references stay unknown because its member-internal __lock_file/__ftell_lk/__unlock_file relocations sit in the component's unresolved set, and the controller refined the finding's guessed _abs terminal 0x00644F3D to 0x00644F45 (the 11-byte cdq/xor/sub magnitude idiom) on archive-member evidence; no scope, baseline or acceptance change is requested.
